name: What measurements or details do I need before framing a window opening?

mainEntity.name: What measurements or details do I need before framing a window opening?

acceptedAnswer.text: You typically need the window unit’s exact rough-opening requirements, the wall thickness, and the location of nearby studs, headers, and any electrical or plumbing. In the Denver metro area, it also helps to know whether the home is in a city that requires permits for new or resized openings. Clear measurements upfront reduce the risk of a window that fits poorly or needs costly reframing.
acceptedAnswer.description: Have the window’s rough-opening specs, wall thickness, and existing framing details ready. If you’re in Denver or nearby cities, also check whether the project needs a permit.
